sentences.text:
For the Petitioner: Mr. Saurabh Shekhar, Advocate For the O.P-State: Mr. P.C. Sinha, A.C to G.A-III ---
08 / 16.04.2024 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jugsalai P.S. Case No. 20 of 2022 for the offences registered under sections 406, 417, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code,
pending in the court of Sri Narendra Kumar, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Jamshedpur.
3.
Petitioner is said to have taken loan of Rs. 120 crores from SIDBI for enhancement of production in Assay Ceramics and Chemical Private Limited.

entities.text: Assay Ceramics and Chemical Private Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Petitioner defaulted in payment of loan.
4. It was submitted that entire premises and machinery of the factory were mortgaged to the SIDBI.
It was further submitted that as the business of the petitioner had gone south, they could not repay the loan amount.

It was further submitted that Financial Institution SIDBI has agitated the matter before the Debt Recovery Tribunal for realization of the loan amount and the assets of the company is worth more than Rs. 120 crores.
5. Mr. P.C. Sinha, learned A.C to G.A-III has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the petitioner has one another case pending against him and he is a habitual offender.

6. Supplementary affidavit has been filed stating therein that the case which has been referred to by the prosecution, is not with regard to the default in payment of loan amount, but this is with regard to milling of paddy.

entities.text: Binod Kumar Goyal vs The State Of Jharkhand on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid facts, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Narendra Kumar, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Jamshedpur

in connection with Jugsalai P.S. Case No. 20 of 2022, subject to the condition that the entire assets and property including the immovable property shall not be disposed of till the disposal of the case filed by SIDBI before the Debt Recovery Tribunal.

(Ambuj Nath, J) Ranjeet/
